schema.text: How do air quality and pollution levels (e.g. exhaust fumes, dust, or unpleasant odours) affect your journey?

options.text: I notice it but it doesn't change my behaviour
It causes me health problems (e.g. coughing, asthma)
It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. wearing a mask, keeping windows closed)
It makes me change my route or travel at a different time

it.#How do air quality and pollution levels: In che modo la qualità dell'aria e i livelli di inquinamento (ad es. gas di scarico, polvere o odori sgradevoli) influiscono sul tuo spostamento?
it.#I notice it but it doesn't change my be: Me ne accorgo, ma non modifica il mio comportamento
it.#It makes me change my route or travel a: Mi porta a cambiare percorso o a spostarmi in un orario diverso
it.#It makes me switch to a different mode: Mi porta a scegliere una modalità di trasporto completamente diversa
it.#It causes me health problems (e.g. coug: Mi provoca disturbi di salute (ad es. tosse, asma)
it.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. w: Mi porta a modificare il modo in cui mi sposto (ad es. indossare una mascherina, tenere i finestrini chiusi)

fr.#How do air quality and pollution levels: Comment la qualité de l’air et la pollution, par exemple les gaz d’échappement, la poussière ou les mauvaises odeurs, influencent-elles votre trajet ?
fr.#I notice it but it doesn't change my be: Je le remarque, mais cela ne change pas ma façon de me déplacer
fr.#It makes me change my route or travel a: Cela me fait changer d’itinéraire ou d’heure de déplacement
fr.#It makes me switch to a different mode: Cela me fait choisir un autre mode de transport
fr.#It causes me health problems (e.g. coug: Cela me cause des problèmes de santé (par ex. toux, asthme)
fr.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. w: Cela m’amène à adapter ma façon de me déplacer (par ex. porter un masque, garder les vitres fermées)

de.#How do air quality and pollution levels: Wie beeinflussen Luftqualität und Verschmutzung, zum Beispiel Abgase, Staub oder unangenehme Gerüche, Ihren Weg?
de.#I notice it but it doesn't change my be: Ich bemerke es, aber es verändert mein Verhalten nicht
de.#It makes me change my route or travel a: Ich ändere meine Route oder fahre zu einer anderen Zeit
de.#It makes me switch to a different mode: Ich wechsle ganz zu einem anderen Verkehrsmittel
de.#It causes me health problems (e.g. coug: Es verursacht mir gesundheitliche Beschwerden (z. B. Husten, Asthma)
de.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. w: Ich passe an, wie ich unterwegs bin (z. B. Maske tragen, Fenster geschlossen halten)

tr.#How do air quality and pollution levels: Hava kalitesi ve kirlilik, örneğin egzoz dumanı, toz veya kötü kokular, yolculuğunuzu nasıl etkiliyor?
tr.#It makes me change my route or travel a: Güzergâhımı değiştirmeme veya farklı bir saatte seyahat etmeme neden olur
tr.#It makes me switch to a different mode: Tamamen farklı bir ulaşım seçeneğine geçmeme neden olur
tr.#It causes me health problems (e.g. coug: Bende sağlık sorunlarına yol açıyor (örneğin öksürük, astım)
tr.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. w: Yolculuk biçimimi değiştirmeme neden oluyor (örneğin maske takmak, camları kapalı tutmak)

fa.#How do air quality and pollution levels: کیفیت هوا و آلودگی، مانند دود اگزوز، گردوغبار یا بوی نامطبوع، چگونه بر سفر شما اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#I notice it but it doesn't change my be: متوجه می‌شوم، اما رفتارم را تغییر نمی‌دهد
fa.#It makes me change my route or travel a: باعث می‌شود مسیر یا زمان سفر را تغییر دهم
fa.#It makes me switch to a different mode: باعث می‌شود کاملاً روش دیگری را برای رفت‌وآمد انتخاب کنم
fa.#It causes me health problems (e.g. coug: برایم مشکلات سلامتی ایجاد می‌کند (مثلاً سرفه، آسم)
fa.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. w: باعث می‌شود شیوه رفت‌وآمدم را تنظیم کنم (مثلاً ماسک زدن، بسته نگه داشتن پنجره‌ها)

hu.#How do air quality and pollution levels: Hogyan befolyásolja a levegő minősége és a szennyezés, például a kipufogógáz, por vagy kellemetlen szag az utazását?
hu.#I notice it but it doesn't change my be: Észreveszem, de nem változtatja meg a viselkedésemet
hu.#It makes me change my route or travel a: Megváltoztatom az útvonalat vagy más időpontban utazom
hu.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. w: Miatta változtatok a közlekedésem módján (például maszkot viselek, zárva tartom az ablakot)

ar.#How do air quality and pollution levels: كيف تؤثر جودة الهواء والتلوث، مثل عوادم المركبات أو الغبار أو الروائح غير المستحبة، في رحلتك؟
ar.#It makes me change my route or travel a: يجعلني أغيّر الطريق أو أتنقل في وقت مختلف
ar.#It makes me switch to a different mode: يجعلني أختار وسيلة نقل مختلفة تمامًا
ar.#It causes me health problems (e.g. coug: يسبب لي مشكلات صحية (مثل السعال أو الربو)
ar.#It makes me adjust how I travel (e.g. w: يدفعني إلى تعديل طريقة تنقلي (مثل ارتداء كمامة أو إبقاء النوافذ مغلقة)
